title: Choosing a sampler from real renders and measures

questions.q: What does the ddim sampler name run in this version of ComfyUI?
options: Euler, with different noise for masked regions
The full DDIM algorithm from its paper
questions.answer: Euler, with different noise for masked regions
questions.why: sampler_object builds it with ksampler('euler', inpaint_options={'random': True}). Our renders on one seed have the same pixels.

questions.q: Our sweep has one seed per sampler. What can it fairly show?
options: That a choice makes a difference, and what kind
That heun is sharper in general
questions.answer: That a choice makes a difference, and what kind
questions.why: One seed and one prompt show a difference. They cannot rank.

questions.q: What does a low error on the bench mean?
options: The solver follows its equation closely on a toy with no image
The sampler adds less noise to images
questions.answer: The solver follows its equation closely on a toy with no image
questions.why: The bench has no network and no picture.

questions.q: Which question should you settle first when choosing a sampler?
options: Whether you want noise added at each step
How many letters are in the name
Which one the most packs use
questions.answer: Whether you want noise added at each step
questions.why: In our renders that split the results with no overlap: 20.92 to 30.17 against 45.92 to 75.13.

questions.q: At CFG 7 and 20 steps, how do heun and dpmpp_2m compare in cost?
questions.why: Calls are 39 and 20, and CFG above 1 doubles them.
